findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_logo, get_earnings_transcripts, get_social_media, get_healthcare_market, get_government_activity · Private data: get_company_documents, get_ma_transactions, get_healthcare_market, get_property, get_politician_trades, search_healthcare_providers, get_healthcare_provider · Public sink: get_shareholders, get_economic_metrics, get_healthcare_market, get_short_interest, search_properties, get_property, get_housing_area_insights, get_politician_trades, get_government_activity, get_patents, search_healthcare_providers, get_healthcare_provider · Destructive: get_government_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_logo, get_earnings_transcripts, get_social_media, get_healthcare_market, get_government_activity · Private data: get_company_documents, get_ma_transactions, get_healthcare_market, get_property, get_politician_trades, search_healthcare_providers, get_healthcare_provider · Public sink: get_shareholders, get_economic_metrics, get_healthcare_market, get_short_interest, search_properties, get_property, get_housing_area_insights, get_politician_trades, get_government_activity, get_patents, search_healthcare_providers, get_healthcare_provider · Destructive: get_government_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
